declared_deviations: Scope: not part of the gun; L2/F6 use the blockout scope (traced revolve + turret drums + ring blocks) as a stand-in until W1b builds SM_Att_Scope_LongRange
TOP: compared raw and with declared conventions (knob window, spec I1; bounded Y-only fit for the floor-shadow bias I2 and the round-part inflation); TOP is non-authority
Barrel OD per spec (35.2 -> 31.8, Q3 accepted): the sheet's silhouette draws it ~31-32 mm over the forend front

Riser: side skirts and the front block added (the sheet draws the riser as a closed block down to the butt and a front block over a background gap); the riser lever moved below the skirts' travel (GL draws it at Z -10)
Bipod clamp: a wide jaw plate (Y +-25) over a narrow swivel housing (Y +-9) so the folded legs cant +-15 beside it (W0's analytic folded-cant worst 7.7 mm)
Inner leg OD 15.9 (spec rod 12.7) to sit in the 16.4 tube bore at the sliding row (0.25 radial)
Magazine body top Z -20.0 with feed lips + top round up to Z -11 through the receiver feed port (the spec shelf -11.5 sits inside the round receiver; the shelf is at -19.7)
Mag release paddle built 3.4 mm behind the drawn lever (spec); hook 8.8 wide in a 9.6 notch
Pressed magazine ribs are recessed 0.8 (proud ribs would not pass the 0.3 well clearance)
Edge breaks on the chassis / butt / riser 1.0 x 45 (spec 0.6): the L8 fix round (judges: razor slab edges)
Grip bottom Z -166.19 vs spec -166.4 (the polymer contour smoothing of the traced bottom; 0.2 mm, under 0.1 px)

UD repair (gunlib ud.repair, strip collapses limited to 0.03 mm, kept only when not worse) on every part except chassis, bolt_handle and magazine, where it moved gate-critical surfaces (the inlet lip into the receiver, the knob, the well walls); their remaining Unreal drops are a W2 generator fix at the source
L8 judges: both round-2 judges and round-1 asked for splayed bipod legs; Q2 (straight down) is the user's decision and is kept
